The sun dips below the jagged skyline, painting the heavens in sweeping bands of amber, rose, and deep violet. Glass towers catch the final rays of light, blazing like copper torches against the darkening backdrop while the city below hums with the restless rhythm of rush hour. Long shadows stretch across the streets as streetlights flicker to life one by one, and for one brief, breathtaking moment, the boundary between day and night dissolves into a luminous wash of color that makes even the most hurried commuters pause on the sidewalk and look up in quiet wonder.
